concepts.def: Change in concentration of reactant or product per unit time, with units mol dm⁻³ s⁻¹.
Minimum energy that colliding particles must have for a successful reaction.
Distribution of molecular kinetic energies in a gas at a given temperature.
Substance that increases the reaction rate by providing an alternative path of lower activation energy, unchanged at end.
rate = k[A]ᵐ[B]ⁿ, where m and n are orders determined experimentally.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Kinetics & Equilibria — a core area of A-Level Chemistry.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Kinetics & Equilibria brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Kinetics & Equilibria.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
